class_name: 願望-働きかけ-ネガイタイ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1: author → mechanical attachment gate → cold review → fixes applied → gate re-run

glosses: I would like to ask you to …
patterns.usage_note: 〜願いたい is stiff written-formal, at home in notices, business letters, and official announcements. It normally attaches with no particle, to お/ご + a verbal noun (ご確認願いたい) or お + a masu-stem (お送り願いたい); a bare 確認願いたい without ご is curt and rare. を is also possible with noun requests (ご援助を願いたい), while 〜をお願いしたい is the softer, more personal alternative. Compared with 〜ていただきたい it is more distant and impersonal, and 願いたい is the writer-side notice form: spoken announcements use 願います (お待ち願います).

examples.ruby: 詳細[しょうさい]については担当者[たんとうしゃ]にご確認[かくにん]願[ねが]いたい。
examples.english: For details, we ask that you check with the person in charge.

examples.ruby: 資料[しりょう]は締[し]め切[き]りの前日[ぜんじつ]までにお送[おく]り願[ねが]いたい。
examples.english: We ask that the materials be sent in by the day before the deadline.

examples.ruby: 開演[かいえん]までロビーで静[しず]かにお待[ま]ち願[ねが]いたい。
examples.english: Patrons are asked to wait quietly in the lobby until curtain.
